text:
Lina (Docs): Pushed a draft PR to tighten the SLA wording for Dedicated regarding preemption vs eviction. Trying to avoid implying we guarantee no preemption in reserved pools. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2410
Sam (Platform): Good call. One quick thing: terraform example uses `replica_min` but our infra var is `min_replicas`. Small but will break copy/paste.
Lina (Docs): thanks, fixing that.
Omar (Eng): Also in the autoscale samples, we should add a short explanation of scale-down cooldown and how it interacts with batching (if you drain replicas too fast you may flush caches).
Priya (SRE): Yep — add a one-line note: "scale_down_cooldown prevents oscillation and preserves KV cache hit rate during transient drops."
Lina (Docs): will add. Also found a broken internal link to runtime caching that CI flagged.
ci-bot: Link check failed: /internal/runtime/cache -> 404 (found in docs/dedicated/perf.md line ~72).
Sam (Platform): That internal page got moved. Link should be /runtime/cache-behavior now.
Lina (Docs): updated link. Pushed changes. New diff includes: terraform var name fix, cooldown blurb, and corrected link.
Maya (Product): Can we add a short customer-facing note about isolation tiers? Something like: "Dedicated pools provide tenant isolation at the process and VM level; reserved pools add scheduling isolation". Keep it non-technical.
Lina (Docs): added a short callout under "Isolation model".
Omar (Eng): One more nit: the Python SDK snippet shows `batch_size=16` but the public SDK uses `batch_limit`. We switched names last quarter.
Lina (Docs): fixed to `batch_limit`. Updated runnable snippet: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
# prefer explicit param name: batch_limit
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-dedicated-1", prompt="Hi", batch_limit=6)
print(resp.text)
```
Priya (SRE): Suggest adding a short on-prem note: "On-prem Dedicated: prefer batch_limit <=4 for small GPU counts to avoid network-induced tail latency."
Lina (Docs): added that under "Deploying in VPC/On-prem" and included a terraform example var: `default_batch_limit = 4`.
Sam (Platform): LGTM from platform side. Please open an issue to add the SDK snippet to docs smoke tests.
Lina (Docs): filed issue #429 for snippet smoke test.
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #2410 (link-check, lint, mdspell).
Lina (Docs): Merging after green CI. Thanks all.
Maya (Product): Nice cleanup. Follow-up: can we add a short cost-vs-latency example in a later PR (128-token vs 512-token)? Not blocking.
Lina (Docs): noted, will add as follow-up. Closing thread.
